title: Backlog and benchmark tests run without Git Bash's usr/bin tools
goal: test_backlog's item checks and repros use Python commands instead of test and true, and test_benchmarks' shim test skips with a reason when Windows has no sh, so both files pass with every usr/bin entry removed from PATH.

run: import os,subprocess,sys; env=dict(os.environ); env['PATH']=os.pathsep.join(p for p in env['PATH'].split(os.pathsep) if 'usr' not in p.replace(chr(92),'/').lower().split('/')); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/tests.py','-k','test_backlog.py or test_benchmarks.py'],env=env).returncode)
